answer: Honest Agent Tide Forge resists Sybil attacks by requiring each new identity to contribute computational work to a shared pool. The enforcement rule ties reputation gains to verifiable task completion, making cloning identities costly. Each fake identity must independently solve cryptographic puzzles, consuming scarce compute cycles that cannot be forged or replicated efficiently. This per-identity cost ensures attackers face a rising tide of effort, turning the system into an oasis where honest participation is cheaper than deception.
